title: Symbols for a machine record
statement: For types $Q$ and $T$, let the record alphabet consist of four kinds of symbols: a binary digit carrying a Boolean value; a work-cell symbol carrying an optional Boolean content and a Boolean indicating whether the head is there; a state symbol carrying an optional state in $Q$; and a tag symbol carrying an element of $T$.
